verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents that admins can 'adjust spend limits instantly' and set custom card limits, and its MCP server can update card spending limits. This means a finance lead can raise per-card limits directly. However, nothing describes a request workflow for a transaction limit increase, a dedicated self-service screen, or raising company-level or issuer-imposed transaction limits. Missing for 10: a documented limit-increase request flow and approval routing, details of the self-service UI, coverage of account/transaction-level (not just card) limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
